01Why now

Why this course, and why now

Most architecture problems are decisions nobody wrote down, made against goals nobody measured. At this level you learn to state quality in numbers, compare options against them, and leave a record that people and AI coding tools can both follow.

02Outcomes

What you will be able to do

Measure quality

Write quality scenarios with numbers for speed, availability, security and cost.

Decide with evidence

Compare options against your scenarios and choose with the trade-offs in plain sight.

Record decisions

Write decision records that a new team member, or an AI agent, can act on.

Review a design

Test a design against its own scenarios and find the weak spots before they ship.

04The lab

Your quality and decisions record

Take the system you documented at Level 1 and add what it was missing: measured quality goals, the decisions behind the design, and a review of the risks. One project, built in steps after each lesson. Each step has instructions, a finished example, a health check, and saves on your device.

The steps

  1. Build a quality tree with numbers
  2. Write six quality scenarios
  3. Write latency and capacity budgets
  4. Set an availability target and an error budget
  5. Add cost and security with numbers
  6. Find and resolve quality conflicts
  7. Write constraints and drivers
  8. Compare options for a decision
  9. Write three decision records
  10. Plan and record a spike
  11. Sort decisions by reversal cost
  12. Test boundaries with change scenarios
  13. Write interface contracts
  14. Write the data ownership table
  15. Write fitness functions
  16. Run a risk storm
  17. Run a scenario-based review
  18. Write risks and debt for section 11
  19. Draft and review a record with an assistant
  20. Write agent rules and run the final review

What the health check looks for

  • Every quality goal has a number
  • Every decision lists at least two options and why one lost
  • Every scenario can be tested
  • Every risk has an owner and a response
